system.description:
Authoritarian, hot-tempered, and menacing, El Jefe commands his henchmen to seize control of the situation.

Name

Choose a name from one of these lists, or make up your own:

  • Catalina, Dulcina, Evangelina, Marcia, Soraya.

  • Eladio, Ernesto, Federico, Octavio, Roberto.

Look

Choose at least one option from each list:

  • Business-like hair, gelled hair, jet hair, styled hair.

  • Angry eyes, paranoid eyes, searching eyes, sultry eyes.

  • Formal clothes, uniform clothes, expensive clothes, understated clothes.

Your Question

  • Are you taking control of this situation?

Relationships

  • __________ has been a thorn in your side and a constant irritation.

  • __________ is an object of beauty you have sworn to possess.

Conditions

  • Reactive: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.ZG3GSRjBqIiTmB0Z]{act with desperation}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuse someone of lying}.

  • Raging: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out with voice or violence}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.iev5oXkeRFpO0Mgi]{spot something out of place}.

  • Righteous: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.TcWPAx8tGRie1Sb6]{demand what you deserve}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.3EdfFL5zzGRV5Oxt]{manipulate a superior}.

  • Lustful: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express your love passionately}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.wQO9aJp5sChjcoUG]{process your feelings out loud}.

Meltdown

They think they can manipulate you, displace you. They don't understand—you own them!
You directly confront the worst offender and hurt them. You show them that you don't need money or backup. Maybe you destroy things they love. Maybe you cut some throats. Tomorrow you'll have to wash your hands and play nice...but tonight the blood on your knuckles will match the rage in your heart.

Last Time On

At the beginning of each episode, choose one from the list below and cross it off. Once all are gone, it's time for the series finale.

  • You showed someone a moment of tender weakness.

  • You swore to take revenge against someone important.

  • You took over a business or political seat as an interim leader.

  • You revealed that you know a secret truth hidden from someone.

  • You lost something truly valuable that you must recover.

  • You lost your temper and hurt one of your associates.

  • You tightened your grip on something until it snapped.

Thugs

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.wWx0NWU8412n505s]{Thugs}

You have a small crew ready to enforce your plans, about 4–6 people. Give them names. When you send them to rough up a target, answer the following questions, and roll the dice:

  • Is it an easy assignment?

  • Is the crew well rested and in good health?

On a hit (7+), they show up to rough up your target. On a 7-9, your target chooses one. On a 10+, your target chooses two:

  • The crew makes a clear demand; your target gives your crew what you're looking for.

  • The crew beats up your target; your target marks a condition.

  • The crew intimidates your target; your target gives up something else of value to appease them.

Moves

CHOOSE ONE.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.IqbXaRSht9EGjost]{Bitter Rage}

While you have Raging marked, take an extra +1 to the bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out}. When you have Raging marked and roll a 10+ on strike out while physically attacking someone, you may choose to immediately knock them out.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.rVsO4EFhqhTGMpqR]{Dangerous Passion}

When you angrily @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express your love}, you may mark a condition to move a miss (6-) to a 7-9, or a 7-9 to a 10+.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.t6lHXEE8PuiaBzec]{Plata o Plomo}

When you @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.TcWPAx8tGRie1Sb6]{demand what you deserve} and you have the physical upper hand, they mark an additional condition if they refuse and escalate.
